flags.finding: The screenplay features Stealers Wheel's 1972 musical composition 'Stuck in the Middle with You' (written by Gerry Rafferty and Joe Egan) synchronized directly to the pivotal sequence in S019 and S021 where Mr. Blonde tortures, mutilates the ear of, and prepares to immolate a captive police officer while singing along to the track. Incorporating a musical composition into an audiovisual production requires a synchronization license from the copyright owners and music publishers. The underlying publishing rights are controlled by Baby Bun Music Ltd c/o Sony Music Publishing (formerly Sony/ATV) and Stage Three Songs / BMG; ownership splits should be confirmed via Songview prior to formal negotiation. Given the extremely violent and sadistic framing of the scene, publisher approval will require explicit script/scene context disclosure and may carry substantial licensing fees or refusal risk if rights holders restrict violent portrayals. If synchronization approval cannot be secured, the production must replace the cue with an alternative licensed commercial track or original score.
